import os
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
import re
G=load()
di,do=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) for v in [grid[i][j]] if v!=bg]
    # connected components on non-bg (4-conn)
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    from collections import deque
    cellmap={(i,j):v for i,j,v in cells}
    for c in cells:
        if (c[0],c[1]) in seen: continue
        comp=[]; q=deque([(c[0],c[1])]); seen.add((c[0],c[1]))
        while q:
            i,j=q.popleft(); comp.append((i,j,cellmap[(i,j)]))
            for di_,dj_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=i+di_,j+dj_
                if (a,b) in cellmap and (a,b) not in seen:
                    seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
        comps.append(comp)
    big=max(comps,key=len)
    others=[c for comp in comps if comp!=big for c in comp]
    big.sort(key=lambda c:(c[0],c[1]))
    anchor=big[1]  # second cell
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,j,v in others:
        for (bi,bj,bv) in big:
            ti,tj=i+(bi-anchor[0]), j+(bj-anchor[1])
            if 0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w: out[ti][tj]=bv
    return out
print(transform(di)==do)
out=transform(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out) if False else out)
import json
print(json.dumps(out))
